Mod.Name: Rebirth Flame Plus (Character Textures)
Mod.Author: Fated Courage + Slimebucket
Mod.Description:
Rebirth Flame Plus Version 3.0 now out! Now works seamlessly with REMASTERED Edition and OG 2013! OG Upscaled option added
For players who want character textures that closely resemble the original style of the game, just higher resolution.
2 options of textures, either striaght OG upscaled, or Devina edit, which is slightly stylized but not as much as MAGO from poly up.
Original mod Flame Rebirth 1.3 by Fated Courage J8 port, and extra texture work, eye fix by Slimebucket
